about: Daily normal maximum temperature, 1991-2020, for IMD's departure-from-normal heatwave rule. tmax[d] is tenths of degC for day d of a non-leap year (0 = 1 Jan; 29 Feb uses 28 Feb).
source: IMD gridded daily Tmax 1 deg (Srivastava et al. 2009, IMD Pune), 1991-2020; elevation Copernicus DEM via Open-Meteo
method: 30-year calendar-day mean, centred 15-day smoothing, bilinear from cell centres, lapse -6.5 degC/km from cell mean height; districts at >= 600 m shifted so their May mean equals ERA5 May 2016-2020 (era5_offset_c)
